check-ids: definition-digest/<key>, definition-count, key-encoding/NN (index into the file's key_encoding), case/<vector>/<axis>, plus the implementation's own checks (native: unsigned-map-equals-signed, key-encoding-count, property/*; probity: payload-digest)
key-source: Probity's selection.json at the pinned commit, not the key in the vector file
pass-rule: a check passes when the implementation's output equals the value the vector file states for it; otherwise it fails
